notes.title: Elementers 1.5.0 Work in progress!
notes.content:
[h2]The new version will include 3 NEW big systems as well as code improvements on other systems[/h2]

[h3]Co-op Mission Menu and system[/h3]
Supports co-op story missions with up to other 3 players. Build on top of the already existing PVP game mode system!
New difficulties unlock upon completion!
Missions can be locked until the player has reached a specific level to start the mission.
Some missions will also require some specific abilities or elements equipped, the players who join do not have any requirements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45043015/731f64f3a86e1ddf915a1e79162364d8b65b0c8b.gif[/img]

[h3]Revive[/h3]
If your friend gets knocked down, you will have 30 seconds to pick him up!
The revive menu has randomized messages.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45043015/b8a4ff97ee83d32467b6735e710e049dc2ab614a.gif[/img]

[h3]Spectate[/h3]
If you can't revive your friend in time, he will be able to spectate, and you will have to carry his body until the next checkpoint! Of course that's If you are a true friend, if not you can also just pick him up and throw him in a corner.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45043015/6c397fc0df800d11dba61ea3443af54035d93ec9.png[/img]

There is still more work to be done on the new version, and then a LOT more work when designing the first real mission, which will also be part of the story.
Currently, I'm spending more time making the foundation strong, so I will be able to design missions faster.

There is also a plan for player made missions on the marketplace, which will be displayed separately from the original ones.

notes.title: Elementers 1.4.4
notes.content:
-Rewrote how gamemodes are stored and the host/logic, now I can easily add more gamemodes.

-Added a PVP gamemode Menu, now the training npc has an option to show casual gamemodes and competitive modes which will show a list of gamemodes

-Added a Public Duel gamemodes with public matchmaking. Now You can play with strangers!

-Added transitions Ui effect on scenes

-Added more detailed Outlines, white means generic intractable object, blue means that the action can be done when interacting with that object, read means an object which can do something when damaged

notes.title: Elementers 1.4.0 Beta test
notes.content:
Elementers 1.4.0 Work in progress.
You can try out the new version by switching to the testing branch, that's where the new version of the game will first be uploaded for testing and when it seems ready it will be added to the release version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45043015/5a017a00cc93de753f91ad5f680f3af27c6805bd.png[/img]

The 1.4.0 version has:
• A chat system, you can press T to open a chat box, messages are shown above the player's head similar to Roblox, 4 messages can be shown at the same time,[i] it already works.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45043015/4908c83d747598e8daa6bfec4509ce78d841ba36.png[/img]

• A new way of storing gamemode data and a new way of hosting/joining a game, this will give me more flexibility when adding new gamemodes. 
The invite popup also gets the information from the gamemode data to display it in the popup, and there is also support for random maps for gamemodes. [i]Still work in progress because it's bugged. :)) [/i]

• A new Fire ability, [b]Flame Guard[/b] left click to equip a temporary shield, or right click to give the shield to another entity for half of its health. Good for future Co-op pve missions to give your friends shields. [i]Already working, might need some balancing.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45043015/5742b229c528fe8ea84c525678475caf2aa2ac5e.png[/img]

• A new earth ability, [b]Earth Armor[/b], once the ability is invoked, rise dirt from the ground and compress it into a permanent armor. The armor gets visible damaged when taking damage. 
[i]Work in progress, it's hidden from the current build because It's not fully made.[/i]
